stories.title: Kentucky lawmakers want answers after construction timeline for new VA hospital gets pushed back
stories.summary: Louisville's new VA Hospital won't open to patients until 2028. Construction crews broke ground on the facility in 2021.

stories.title: Morgan McGarvey takes on new leadership role during next Congress
stories.summary: Congressman Morgan McGarvey won a third term to represent Jefferson County in the U.S. House during the midterm elections.

stories.title: Warrant issued after release of woman indicted in fatal Trimble County crash
stories.summary: The crash happened on June 16, but the indictment against Mary May wasn't returned until Nov. 6.

stories.title: Would you move to this Kentucky city for $20,000? New program wants to pay you
stories.summary: The initiative is addressing workforce shortages in hard-to-fill positions.

stories.title: New rule expanding bicycling and horseback riding access at Mammoth Cave in Kentucky
stories.summary: The rule is in support of the Trump Administration’s goal of “Making America Beautiful Again by Improving Our National Parks."

stories.title: Louisville man charged with arson after October house fire
stories.summary: The two victims were home when he allegedly started the fire, police said.

stories.title: 'We ran out of money': Hermitage Farms starts discussions on 165 acre commercial project
stories.summary: The 700-acre farm recently sold 165 acres with a new proposal to re-zone the land.

stories.title: This southern Indiana singer won New Artist of the Year at the CMA Awards
stories.summary: Stephen Wilson Jr. won his first CMA Award. He's currently nominated for four total awards.

stories.title: Simon Bird's belief helped carry Lou City to USL Championship Final
stories.summary: Louisville City FC will face Sacramento Republic FC in the USL Championship Final on Nov. 21 at noon.

stories.title: Shepherdsville Aquatic Park close to opening as construction nears finish line
stories.summary: Mayor Jose Cubero said the park could open as early as the first week of January. The outdoor portion will open in the spring.

stories.title: Black medical scholarship from 1952 caught in UofL’s DEI compliance fight
stories.summary: The university's foundation and Kentucky's attorney general are trying to overturn a judge's ruling that said the scholarship could continue as intended.

stories.title: Select Humana employees expected to start returning to offices in 2027
stories.summary: The company is going to create Talent Hubs in nine U.S. cities, and select employees will be expected to work in those offices at least three days a week.
